verdicts.reason: A drops the logo entirely, puts the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow below the body copy so the reading order is wrong, sets the body and 'Ships late June' at an unreadable size, and leaves a big dead gap before the CTA. Its headline is still the clear focal point and the CTA sits cleanly at the right. B keeps the logo, but the white panel behind it is gone, so the dark mark on navy is nearly invisible. B's headline is so small it barely outranks the body copy, the eyebrow is scattered on the CTA row, and there's a stray white sliver in the top-right corner plus a loose dash, so its hierarchy is weaker overall.
